## About

Hi, I'm Emma (she/her), a PhD student at the University of Strathclyde in the [MSP research group](https://msp.cis.strath.ac.uk/) in Glasgow, under the supervision of [Bob Atkey](https://bentnib.org/) and [Guillaume Allais](https://gallais.github.io/). I'm currently working on correct-by-construction optimisations and representations of data types.

I did an MEng at Imperial College London in Joint Maths & Computer Science, then worked in London as a software engineer for 5 years. In my day-to-day, I use Agda for proofs and Haskell for general coding.
